nodes.title: Two kinds of student, two methods
nodes.summary: Sort loud vs quiet students first. Extroverts → three C; introverts → three R. DISC is finer coaching tune only.

nodes.title: Three C method (extroverts)
nodes.summary: Controversial / Common interest / Conflict → take a side in plain words → reactive content.

nodes.title: Three R method / routine (introverts)
nodes.summary: Read news / book / article → add own view → daily video. Starting device; not authority alone.

nodes.title: GOAT / Four Beats
nodes.summary: Grab attention → Open a question → Answer it → Take it away. Short structure students remember.

nodes.title: Longer story structure (Problem→Search→…)
nodes.summary: Problem → Search → Story → Solution → What next. Search creates the story.

nodes.title: Eight ways to open (first three seconds)
nodes.summary: Eight opening types; lead with viewer problem; edit loudest moment to front.

nodes.title: What counts as a hit (100× followers)
nodes.summary: Hit = 100× follower count. Multiple scales with audience; bilingual 一百倍就是爆款.

nodes.title: The waffle (3×3 idea grid)
nodes.summary: 3×3 waffle: centre who you are and serve; eight themes; 5 formats × themes ≈ 100 videos. Overlaps 九宫格.

nodes.title: Fixing content that is not working (two checklists)
nodes.summary: Nobody watching: business→method→words→positioning. No ideas: fix positioning, loud/quiet, fill grid, AI draft.

nodes.title: Positioning (four questions, then the crown)
nodes.summary: Sell what/who/why then what you are the most of → king of category. Two brand directions: who are you / why you.

nodes.title: Brand stance model (for / against / known for)
nodes.summary: Stand for + stand against recorded. Recommended third: known for doing. Confirm wording with Jeff before teaching as confirmed.

nodes.title: Six caption angles (one line)
nodes.summary: One-line captions: sore point, argument, myth, flat statement, turn, plain account.

nodes.title: THE 4 CONTENT LAYERS
nodes.summary: Story / Case / POV / News. Lead with Story; prove with Case; differentiate with POV; borrow attention from News. Not 四种内容资产.

nodes.title: Content Authority Ladder / 内容权威阶梯
nodes.summary: News→POV→Case→Story. Higher: more yours, stronger trust, harder to copy.

nodes.title: Borrowed-material-only content does not build authority alone
nodes.summary: Content built entirely on other people's material introduces the audience to the source, not the person. Three R is a starting device.
